Some of you may feel it's too difficult to attain the thresholds required for expanded upvoats and gaining the ability to downvoat. This confuses me to some degree, because it's really very easy to do, if you know how. I managed to attain my thresholds in just a couple days back when there were far less users around to upvoat.

I figured it out quite by accident, just by being a nice guy. The secret garden I referred to in the title is hidden in plain sight. It's been staring you in the face since you first arrived here.

What I am talking about is /v/introductions. Now, I know what you are thinking. "I already made a post there and it didn't give me much CCP at all!"

You are absolutely right, because that's not how you gain your CCP there. You gain it (over one hundred points on some days!) by greeting other users in their threads. Click on the New tab and greet the first poster you see at the top. Greet a few more down the list. Spend a little time there. You don't have to camp there all day, but come back once in a while. Start the process over and greet a few more.

Everyone who visits the post after you will (hopefully) upvoat your comment. The OP certainly will if they have a voat to give. You are providing a community service by contributing while at the same time gaining valuable comment contribution points.

Everyone wins.
The Secret Garden - Attaining Your CCP Thresholds
